sync_architecture.idempotency_rule: Every outbound operation must key idempotency from canonical_dashboard_id, operation_type, and source_change_key.
sync_architecture.retry_rule: Failed provisioning and mirror operations are retried only through integration_sync_operation replay, never through ad hoc reruns.
sync_architecture.reconciliation_rule: Scheduled reconciliation compares canonical dashboard ids, stored Microsoft backlinks, and live Microsoft object ids before updating mirror state.
sync_architecture.failure_queue_rule: Failed and conflict operations remain in integration_sync_operation as the operator-facing failure queue.

canonical_entities.source_of_truth_rule: Organization is the canonical client/account master in the dashboard.
canonical_entities.mirror_scope_rule: Microsoft may mirror client/account context but must not own lifecycle or relationship state.
canonical_entities.notes: Backlinks should open the organization workspace, not a Microsoft-authored record.

canonical_entities.source_of_truth_rule: Jobs are the canonical project/work package in the dashboard.
canonical_entities.mirror_scope_rule: Microsoft mirrors project metadata, collaboration space, and coordination artifacts only.
canonical_entities.notes: Project workspace provisioning should be one idempotent flow anchored to the canonical job id.

canonical_entities.source_of_truth_rule: Job readiness items remain authoritative in the dashboard.
canonical_entities.mirror_scope_rule: Microsoft may mirror requirement state for visibility, but completion/blocker rules stay in the dashboard.
canonical_entities.notes: The dashboard backlink should land on the parent job because required items do not have a standalone shell route.

canonical_entities.source_of_truth_rule: Post-shoot evaluations are the first concrete submission family supported by this contract.
canonical_entities.mirror_scope_rule: Microsoft may mirror submission metadata and files, but submitted content state remains dashboard-owned.
canonical_entities.notes: A broader submission aggregate can replace this family later without changing the provider contract shape.

canonical_entities.source_of_truth_rule: Work tasks are canonical execution tasks in the dashboard.
canonical_entities.mirror_scope_rule: Planner and Lists may mirror coordination state, but task status ownership remains dashboard-side.
canonical_entities.notes: Planner completion never completes the dashboard task.

canonical_entities.source_of_truth_rule: Communication events are projected from dashboard-owned messaging, meetings, and post-call outcomes.
canonical_entities.mirror_scope_rule: Microsoft may mirror event summaries, not become the communication audit source.
canonical_entities.notes: Communication event ids may come from a future unified projection instead of one source table.

fields.notes: Backlink to the dashboard context that owns the submission.

target_objects.notes: Create or update a read-only client/account list item.

provisioning_flows.notes: Client mirrors exist to support lookup, not to move client ownership into Microsoft.

provisioning_flows.source_trigger: Job is published or manually queued for workspace provisioning.

target_objects.notes: Provision or link the primary collaboration channel for the job.
Provision or link the project document folder.
Mirror project metadata into the governed project list.

provisioning_flows.notes: The dashboard remains authoritative for project lifecycle and workflow state.

provisioning_flows.source_trigger: Required item state changes or a record is manually reconciled.

target_objects.notes: Mirror required item state for governed department visibility.

provisioning_flows.notes: Completion and blocker logic remain dashboard-owned.

provisioning_flows.source_trigger: Submission is created or moved to submitted/reviewed state.

target_objects.notes: Link the governed document folder tied to the submission.
Mirror submission state and review summary only.

provisioning_flows.notes: Phase 3 treats post-shoot evaluations as the first submission family.

provisioning_flows.source_trigger: Task is created or materially updated.

target_objects.notes: Mirror dashboard task into Planner for coordination only.

provisioning_flows.notes: Planner bucket movement must not mutate authoritative dashboard task state.

provisioning_flows.source_trigger: Communication event projection is emitted from dashboard communications.

target_objects.notes: Mirror a readable event summary for operational visibility.

provisioning_flows.notes: The communication event mirror is read-only and depends on the dashboard projection layer.

manual replay of failed provisioning operations

execution_order.title: Apply the Phase 3 migration and deploy the API/worker code.
execution_order.rollback: Disable strict validation and roll back the app deployment before removing the new table.

execution_order.title: Validate Phase 1 and Phase 2 diagnostics are clean before queueing provisioning work.
execution_order.rollback: Stop rollout and clear baseline/config issues before proceeding.

execution_order.title: Generate and review the provisioning plan for one pilot project and one pilot task.
execution_order.rollback: Delete the queued pilot operations if naming or ownership is wrong.

execution_order.title: Provision or link the pilot Microsoft objects in the governed tenant structure.
execution_order.rollback: Remove pilot links from the app and archive the pilot Microsoft artifacts.

execution_order.title: Record resolved Microsoft object ids and URLs back into the dashboard link contract.
execution_order.rollback: Mark the links archived or drifted rather than deleting audit history.

execution_order.title: Validate replay, backlink, and reconciliation behavior on the pilot records.
execution_order.rollback: Stop before wider rollout if replay or backlink integrity is unstable.

manual_admin_checklist.step: Confirm the department Teams, SharePoint, Lists, and Planner topology from Phase 2 already exists for the target environment.
Approve the canonical naming patterns and provisioning scope for pilot organizations, jobs, and tasks before any live links are stored.
Provision or identify the actual Microsoft objects for the pilot records and capture their final URLs and ids.
Record those resolved ids/URLs into the dashboard provisioning link endpoint so backlinks and replay are traceable.

validation_checklist: The admin diagnostics endpoint returns the expected canonical entity contract and startup validation output.
A queued Microsoft workspace scaffold operation produces one integration_sync_operation row with a stable source_change_key.
Replaying a failed microsoft365_workspace operation produces a new queued operation instead of mutating the original row.
Recording resolved Microsoft ids creates or updates microsoft_workspace_link rows idempotently.
external_object_map rows are written for resolved Microsoft object ids to preserve cross-provider traceability.
Dashboard backlinks point to the authoritative dashboard record, not to a synthetic Microsoft-owned workflow.
rollback_principles: Do not delete integration_sync_operation history during rollback; mark links archived or drifted instead.
Remove or disable newly linked Microsoft artifacts before widening the provisioning scope.
If a canonical id or field map is wrong, update the version-controlled baseline first, then replay with a new source_change_key.
